stories.title: Price of Brent oil up above $92 per barrel on London’s ICE first since July 30
stories.summary: As of 1:50 a.m. GMT, the price was up by 1.13% at $92.05 a barrel
article_sentences: The price of futures contracts of Brent crude oil for October 2026 delivery on London’s ICE has risen above $92 per barrel for the first time since July 30, 2026, according to trade data.
As of 4:50 a.m. Moscow time (1:50 a.m. GMT), the Brent price was up by 1.13% at $92.05 a barrel.
As of 5:08 a.m. Moscow time (2:08 a.m. GMT), the price of Brent was up by 0.97% reaching $91.9 per barrel.
Meanwhile the price of futures contracts of WTI crude oil for September 2026 delivery was up by 1.46% at $84.96 per barrel.
